url.label: Jellyfin URL
url.description: The base URL of your Jellyfin server.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.description: Create one in Jellyfin under Dashboard > API Keys.

authMethod.label: Auth method
authMethod.description: Newer Jellyfin servers only accept the Authorization header. Automatic sends both, so it works with old and new servers.

headerName.label: Legacy auth header
headerName.description: The header the legacy method sends. Only change it if your server expects a different one.

thumbHeight.label: Thumbnail height in pixels
thumbHeight.description: Jellyfin resizes result thumbnails to this height.

previewHeight.label: Preview image height in pixels
previewHeight.description: Jellyfin resizes the image in the preview panel to this height.
